explanation: Lagaan means land tax. Aamir Khan produced the film and starred as the village's captain. Set in 1893, it was India's third nominee for the Best Foreign Language Film Oscar.

claims.text: Lagaan (2001), a Hindi film about villagers who play a cricket match against British officers to escape a tax, was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.
Devdas, Sholay and Swades were not nominated for an Academy Award.
The Hindi word lagaan means land tax.
Aamir Khan produced Lagaan and played its lead role, the captain of the village team.
Lagaan was the third Indian film nominated for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film, after Mother India (1957) and Salaam Bombay! (1988).
